sysSayLines.line: 📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The storm's leavings, spread across the meadow: berry bushes stripped and scattered, a downed deer, a stranded fish haul flopping in a cut-off pool, fruit everywhere.

All of it is rotting. Right now. On camera. The System, cheerful: "BEAT THE ROT. EAT, DRY, HAUL. THE CLOCK IS SPOILAGE."

📺 You eat the berries — handfuls of them, right there in the meadow, on camera. They're perfect for another hour and gone after that. The audience watches you eat like it's a sport. It kind of is.

📺 The sun climbs. The berries are going. The fish pool is warming — the stranded fish won't survive the afternoon, and neither will their freshness.

The meadow smells like a decision.
📺 You gut and split the fish and get them drying in the sun, salted from your kit. Fish dried today feeds the village in deep winter. The rot loses this round.

📺 Last light. What's saved is saved; what's rotting is compost with an audience.

The System tallies: preserved vs lost. The village watches the numbers.

📺 You lay it out: smoked venison, dried fish, the last of the fruit, berries eaten at their peak. The rot got some. The rot did not get the winter. The village eats for weeks because you worked the rot order.
